rows.text: Complete browser verification also caught lost description input and disappearing nested layout controls. Before evidence is preserved in .harness/migration-save-refresh-before and .harness/migration-splitter-nested-before.

Independent inspection review found a redundant initial detail read/render after refresh had already mounted the editor. It can replace a focused control before its input event. A controlled held-response regression is being recorded before removing that duplicate render; no expected behavior is being weakened.
